events.verdict: [Observable in enhanced video] Williams (NOP) is in the paint without actively guarding an opponent for longer than three seconds.
Johnson (NOP) makes contact to the arm of Towns (MIN) on the rip-through and not during his upward shooting motion.
Randle (NOP) makes incidental contact with Towns's (MIN) foot during the pick but it does not affect his FOM.
Towns (MIN) initiates some contact with Johnson (NOP) in the post but Johnson is able to maintain his position.
Johnson (NOP) makes contact to the off-arm of Towns (MIN) during his shooting motion that does not affect his play at the basket.

Holiday (NOP) makes inadvertent contact with Wiggins's (MIN) face when he enters his shooting motion. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Saric (MIN) makes some forearm contact with Randle (NOP) during the rebound but the contact does not affect his ability to retrieve the ball.
Deng (MIN) makes marginal contact with Holiday (NOP) during the start of the drive that does not affect his SQBR.
Towns (MIN) makes incidental contact to the arm of Holiday (NOP) after the release that does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Towns (MIN) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Frazier (NOP) and gives him room to avoid contact.
Randle (NOP) places a hand/arm to the front of Towns (MIN) during the drive but the contact does not affect his SQBR.
Towns (MIN) makes marginal contact to the body of Randle (NOP) during his shooting motion that does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Teague (MIN) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Randle (NOP) and absorbs contact.
Randle (NOP) briefly grasps Towns's (MIN) arm during the screen but it does not affect his ability to get to the pass.
Holiday (NOP) makes brief contact with Towns's (MIN) jersey during the start of the drive and the contact does not affect his SQBR.
Towns (MIN) makes contact to the arm and body of Randle (NOP) during his shooting motion that affects his play at the basket.
Randle (NOP) makes contact with Towns (MIN) off ball that does not affect his ability to get to the pass.
Randle (NOP) makes marginal contact to the body of Towns (MIN) during his shooting motion that does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Deng (MIN) makes contact with Randle's (NOP) arm during the rebound affecting his ability to gather the ball.
Teague (MIN) commits a take foul on Holiday (NOP).
Gibson (MIN) commits a take foul on Randle (NOP).
Towns (MIN) commits a take foul on Randle (NOP).
